pairs: For I do not want you to be ignorant,
quoniam patres nostri omnes sub nube fuerunt,
brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud,
and they all went across the sea.
et omnes in Moyse baptizati sunt in nube, et in mari:
And in Moses, they all were baptized, in the cloud and in the sea.
et omnes eamdem escam spiritalem manducaverunt,
And they all ate of the same spiritual food.
et omnes eumdem potum spiritalem biberunt (bibebant autem de spiritali,
And they all drank of the same spiritual drink.
they all were drinking of the spiritual rock seeking to obtain them;
sed non in pluribus eorum beneplacitum est Deo:
But with most of them, God was not well-pleased.
For they were struck down in the desert.
Hæc autem in figura facta sunt nostri,
Now these things were done as an example for us,
so that we might not desire evil things,
do not take part in idolatry,
“The people sat down to eat and to drink,
and then they rose up to amuse themselves.”
And let us not commit fornication,
sicut quidam ex ipsis fornicati sunt,
et ceciderunt una die viginti tria millia.
and so twenty-three thousand fell on one day.
And let us not tempt Christ,
and so they perished by serpents.
and so they perished by the destroyer.
Hæc autem omnia in figura contingebant illis:
Now all of these things happened to them as an example,
scripta sunt autem ad correptionem nostram,
and so they have been written for our correction,
because the final age has fallen upon us.
And so, whosoever considers himself to be standing,
let him be careful not to fall.
Tentatio vos non apprehendat nisi humana:
Temptation should not take hold of you, except what is human.
qui non patietur vos tentari supra id quod potestis,
and he will not permit you to be tempted beyond your ability. Instead,
sed faciet etiam cum tentatione proventum ut possitis sustinere.
he will effect his Providence, even during temptation, so that you may be able to bear it.
flee from the worship of idols.
Since I am speaking to those who are prudent,
judge what I say for yourselves.
The cup of benediction that we bless,
is it not a communion in the Blood of Christ?
And the bread that we break,
is it not a participation in the Body of the Lord?
we, though many, are one body:
omnes qui de uno pane participamus.
all of us who are partakers of the one bread.
Are not those who eat from the sacrifices partakers of the altar?
dico quod idolis immolatum sit aliquid?
Should I say that what is immolated to idols is anything?
Or that the idol is anything?
But the things that the Gentiles immolate,
Nolo autem vos socios fieri dæmoniorum:
And I do not want you to become partakers with demons.
You cannot drink the cup of the Lord,
non potestis mensæ Domini participes esse,
You cannot be partakers of the table of the Lord,
and partakers of the table of demons.
Or should we provoke the Lord to jealousy?
Are we stronger than he is?
Let no one seek for himself,
Whatever is sold in the market,
without asking questions for the sake of conscience.
and all its fullness belong to the Lord.”
If you are invited by any unbelievers,
and you are willing to go,
you may eat whatever is set before you,
without asking questions for the sake of conscience.
Si quis autem dixerit: Hoc immolatum est idolis:
But if anyone says, “This has been sacrificed to idols,”
nolite manducare propter illum qui indicavit,
do not eat it, for the sake of the one who told you,
and for the sake of conscience.
But I am referring to the conscience of the other person,
Ut quid enim libertas mea judicatur ab aliena conscientia?
For why should my liberty be judged by the conscience of another?
quid blasphemor pro eo quod gratias ago?
why should I be slandered over that for which I give thanks?
or whatever else you may do,
do everything for the glory of God.
Be without offense toward the Jews,
and toward the Church of God,
sicut et ego per omnia omnibus placeo,
just as I also, in all things, please everyone,
non quærens quod mihi utile est, sed quod multis:
not seeking what is best for myself, but what is best for many others,
so that they may be saved.
